h2: Water Heater Repair & Installation Kerobokan & Umalas
intro: Families living year-round in villas around Kerobokan Kelod and Umalas put steady daily load on their water heaters, so when hot water stops or the breaker trips at breakfast time, the whole household feels it immediately. I handle Water Heater Repair & Installation Kerobokan & Umalas residents need — from swapping a burnt heating element to fitting a brand-new unit where none existed before.

sections.h3: Why Heaters Struggle in Long-Term Villas Here
sections.text: In Kerobokan Kaja and the surrounding lanes you'll find older two-storey villas sitting right beside newer builds. That mix means corroded copper pipework from decades ago and fresh PVC joints can show up in one property. Families who live full-time run showers, dishwashers and laundry back-to-back, so heating elements wear faster than in a weekend rental. A tripped breaker at seven in the morning before school runs is the most common call I get here.

Whether your villa uses an electric tank under the stairs, a gas unit on the terrace, or a rooftop solar system feeding the bathrooms, I diagnose and fix all three. Typical jobs include replacing a cracked heating element, resetting or swapping a faulty thermostat, fitting a new sacrificial anode to stop internal corrosion, and chasing leaks from flanges or pressure-relief valves. For properties that never had hot water plumbed through, I manage the full installation — pipe routing, mounting, electrical connection and first flush.

sections.h3: Send Photos for a Quick Quote
sections.text: Before I head over, send a few photos on WhatsApp: the heater's front panel showing any error codes, the area around the unit so I can see pipework and access, and if it's leaking, where exactly the water pools. A short clip of the breaker tripping helps too. Cost depends entirely on what's wrong and which parts are needed, so I'll give you a clear figure once I've reviewed the images. No obligation to proceed either way.

sections.h3: Keeping Your Heater Running Through Bali's Seasons
sections.text: Kerobokan sits at a similar groundwater level to Canggu, so after heavy rain the soil around septic tanks and drainage swells noticeably. That extra moisture accelerates corrosion on metal fittings near ground level — including heater flanges and anode connections. In Batu Belig and Umalas, bigger gardens with irrigation lines also mean more humidity cycling through outdoor units. A quick visual check every three months plus flushing the tank annually catches small issues before they become a cold-shower emergency.

faq.q: How much does water heater repair cost in Kerobokan?
faq.a: It depends on whether it's a thermostat swap, a new heating element, or a full unit replacement — I'll quote you from photos sent on WhatsApp before any work starts.

faq.q: Can you install a solar water heater on my villa roof?
faq.a: Yes, rooftop solar installations are part of what I do. Send me a photo of your current setup and how you access the roof so I can advise on sizing and pipe routing.

faq.q: My heater keeps tripping the breaker — is that dangerous?
faq.a: A repeatedly tripped breaker usually points to a shorted heating element or a failing thermostat. It's worth getting checked promptly rather than resetting it over and over each morning.
